cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Act as If It’s True
cards.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The ceiling's hungry. Turn the breakfast tray upside down so it can eat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Keep half for us. Just turn its bowl over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll use the tray to catch anything it drops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Hold it under the light fitting; that's where it dribbled yesterday.

mechanism: A supervises a helper's concrete feeding choices as if a hungry ceiling were an ordinary dependent with portions and dribbles.
confusable: D151 recruits belief in an explanation; D155 needs a concrete act only sensible under the impossible premise, without persuasion about truth.
comparison: Portioning scarce breakfast differs from assigning two dinner seats to one time-traveling guest.
seedUse: Keep scarcity and catching solution; make professional corrections target serving and spill handling.
